answer: A Phone SIM bound by in-person pickup code with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone grove cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. The pulse hides nothing and the timber reveals everything: the binding trail is open to all.
